title: VaPR: Vision-language Preference Alignment for Reasoning
authors_zh: Rohan Wadhawan、Fabrice Y. Harel-Canada、Zi-Yi Dou、Suhaila Shakiah、Robinson Piramuthu、Nanyun Peng
paper_type_zh: 视觉语言偏好数据集与对齐方法
best_for_zh: 需要多模态 DPO、视觉推理偏好对或困难负例构造的研究者
one_line: VaPR releases 30,000 vision-language preference pairs whose edited hard negatives control for style and length while targeting reasoning errors.
VaPR-30K 发布超过 3 万视觉推理 chosen/rejected 对，并以困难负例强化细粒度视觉—语言推理偏好学习。
why: Its hard negatives are designed to change reasoning quality without giving away the label through superficial response cues.
inclusion_reason: VaPR provides public vision-language preference records specifically constructed for reasoning-focused preference alignment.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal DPO often uses independently generated or scored chosen/rejected responses, whose lengths and styles differ conspicuously. Models can exploit these surface cues instead of learning visual facts and reasoning differences, especially in spatial, counting, and binary questions.

VaPR starts from high-quality SFT ground-truth responses and asks a text LLM to modify only task-relevant spans, injecting targeted visual or reasoning errors while preserving length and style to create hard-negative preference pairs.

多模态 DPO 常让大模型独立生成或评分 chosen/rejected，负例往往比正例更长、更短或风格明显不同。模型可能利用这些表面线索而不学习图像事实与推理差异，尤其在空间、计数和二值问答中形成伪偏好。

VaPR 从高质量 SFT 真值回答出发，让文本 LLM 只改动任务相关片段，注入定向视觉或推理错误，同时保持长度和语言风格接近，形成难负例偏好对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: VaPR starts from high-quality SFT ground-truth responses and asks a text LLM to modify only task-relevant spans, injecting targeted visual or reasoning errors while preserving length and style to create hard-negative preference pairs. The official VaPR-30K release has about 29.9K records under Apache-2.0, derived from a filtered LLaVA-665K subset. Each item includes an image path, one of ten task types, chosen conversations, and rejected_conversations. GPT-4o creates the main set, while Qwen3-32B produces VaPR-OS to test an open-source editor.

VaPR 从高质量 SFT 真值回答出发，让文本 LLM 只改动任务相关片段，注入定向视觉或推理错误，同时保持长度和语言风格接近，形成难负例偏好对。VaPR-30K 官方集有约 29.9K 条、Apache-2.0 许可，源自 LLaVA-665K 的筛选子集；每条包含 image 路径、10 类 task type、chosen conversations 和 rejected_conversations。主集用 GPT-4o 编辑，另有 Qwen3-32B 生成的 VaPR-OS 用于验证开源编辑器可行性。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Filter LLaVA-665K to remove text-only, MCQ, bounding-box, OCR, and other unsuitable records, and balance Yes/No answers.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Categorize retained samples into ten perception, attribute, spatial, counting, comparison, captioning, and related task types.
  1. Verify and filter: Provide GPT-4o with the instruction, ground-truth response, and task type, editing only key semantic spans; use penalty lists for categories prone to repeated perturbations.
  1. Train and evaluate: Human-audit a stratified sample, form 30K chosen/rejected pairs, and apply DPO to LLaVA, Qwen2-VL, and Qwen2.5-VL families.

1. 建立数据源： 从 LLaVA-665K 删除纯文本、MCQ、框选和 OCR 等不适合难负例编辑的样本，并平衡 Yes/No。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 以关键词把保留样本分为感知、属性、空间、计数、比较、caption 等十类。
  1. 验证与筛选： 向 GPT-4o 提供指令、真值回答和任务类型，只修改关键语义片段；对易重复类别加入 penalty list 增加扰动多样性。
  1. 训练与评测： 抽样人工核验后形成 30K chosen/rejected 对，再用 DPO 微调 LLaVA、Qwen2-VL 和 Qwen2.5-VL。

title: Evidence
证据
html: A stratified human audit of 500 items finds 97% compliance with the hard-negative criteria and 86% annotator agreement. VaPR has word-level edit distance around 6 and average token-length difference around 3, much lower than comparison sets. Average gains are about 6.5% for LLaVA, 4.0% for Qwen2-VL, and 1.5% for Qwen2.5-VL; VaPR-OS reaches roughly 99% of main-set performance. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.

对 500 条分层样本的人工检查显示 97% 符合难负例标准，标注者一致性为 86%；VaPR 的词级编辑距离约 6、平均 token 长度差约 3，明显小于对比偏好集。六类模型在十个基准上的平均增益分别约为 LLaVA 6.5%、Qwen2-VL 4.0%、Qwen2.5-VL 1.5%，VaPR-OS 达到主集模型约 99% 表现。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior multimodal preference data relies on VLM regeneration or judge ranking. VaPR turns negative creation into constrained minimal editing of a trusted chosen response, so the pair differs mainly in the target visual fact and suppresses length/style shortcuts at the source.
已有多模态偏好数据依赖 VLM 重新生成或 judge 排序；VaPR 把负例生成改成对可信 chosen 的受约束最小编辑，使正负样本主要只在目标视觉事实上不同，从数据源头抑制长度和风格捷径。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Chosen responses inherit errors or hallucinations from the source SFT set and are not automatically corrected.
  1. Feedback risk: The text editor does not inspect images; targeted errors depend on task labels and the source answer and may remain correct or become unnatural.
  1. Reproduction and use: Image files inherit upstream LLaVA/COCO licences and paths; releasing records does not imply all images can be redistributed independently.

1. 覆盖边界： chosen 来自原 SFT 真值，若原回答本身含幻觉，编辑流程不会自动纠正。
  1. 反馈风险： 文本编辑器没有直接看图，其定向错误依赖任务标签和原答案，可能产生实际上仍正确或不自然的负例。
  1. 复现与使用： 图像文件继承 LLaVA/COCO 等上游许可与路径，发布记录并不意味着所有图像可独立再分发。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Use it directly for visual-reasoning DPO, especially spatial, counting, attribute, and binary-bias correction.
  1. Training: Reuse minimal editing to generate hard negatives for new visual tasks, with human sampling to confirm that only the target fact changes.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Use it to diagnose preference-data quality through length gap, edit distance, and premature reward-accuracy saturation.

1. 评测： 直接用于视觉推理 DPO，特别适合空间、计数、属性和二值偏差修正。
  1. 训练： 复用最小编辑框架为新视觉任务生成 hard negatives，并用人工抽样确认“只改变目标事实”。
  1. 迁移或部署： 作为偏好数据质量诊断集，比较正负长度差、编辑距离和 reward accuracy 是否过早饱和。
